verdict.rationale: The DGX B300 exposes programmatic management interfaces (Redfish and IPMI via the BMC), so an API reference is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the pack documents an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. The llms.txt files are AI-readable documentation indexes, an adjacent feature that earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
